page0.text:
The clock strikes 2:00 AM.
A round trip to and from Ryudou Temple took its toll on me, in spite of my daily training.

page1.text:
"...Oh, right. Saber, head back to your bedroom ahead of me."
"? Where are you going, Shirou? I thought you were going to rest tonight."

page2.text:
"Um, I got a thing to do. I'll be right back, so don't worry. I'm tired too, so I want to turn in early tonight."
"I see. You must be concerned about Sakura's condition."

page3.text: "Uh. I mean, I should get her more water. Make sure you sleep in the room next to mine, all right? And close the door."

page4.text: "Yes, I will. It's inconvenient not to be in the same room, but if you insist, then I will do so. I will be standing by in the room next to yours."

page5.text:
Saber looks displeased.
...Hmph.
I'm not the only one who's being stubborn.

page6.text:
"..."
I return to my bedroom, tortured by self-loathing.
"3:00 AM... What have I been doing for the past hour?"

page7.text:
I sigh.
There's only one reason I took so long.
Sakura wasn't sleeping very well, so I spent time getting her more water and putting her covers back on.

page8.text: It was...an incredibly taxing job, in more ways than one.

page9.text:
"...I should've blindfolded myself."
That would have made it easier.
...Actually, I had my eyes closed almost the entire time, so it wouldn't have made much difference. Not once did I give into temptation and open them until my work was done.

page10.text:
"...Time for bed.
Just go to sleep. That's all I need to do."
I cover my head with the sheets and drive out the invasive thoughts.

page11.text:
...
Once I close my eyes, my mind goes blank.
...See?
Being this physically tired will help me fall asleep faster.

page12.text:
It's red.
At sunset, the cityscape seems dyed red.
It reminds me of a bench covered in posters.
Everything my feet and hands touch makes a warm, squelching sound.

page13.text:
I continue down the asphalt road.
When I look up, the buildings are dyed crimson.
The steep walls seem like giant nails hammered from the sky to the earth.
You can't run, the red sun declares, gazing down from the heavens.

page14.text:
I walk alone through the streets.
Shinto is dead quiet.
Maybe everyone's hiding in wait, or perhaps there was never anyone here to begin with.

page15.text:
...Still, it hurts.
The scarlet glow torments my eyeballs and makes me dizzy.
It's too empty out here.
Am I the only one who missed some mass evacuation order?
That would explain all the red.

page16.text:
I should go home.
...is waiting for me.

page17.text:
Is that...
...Tohsaka?
Even from afar,
I can tell it's her.

page19.text:
She ignores me.
She walks, her swaying hair long enough to touch the ground.
If she's wearing her uniform, then she must be on the way to school.

page20.text:
I run after her.
Tohsaka doesn't notice me.
The gap between us doesn't shrink at all.
She keeps walking, while I keep running. I gradually fall even further behind.
By the way...

page21.text:
Tohsaka isn't walking at a particular brisk pace.
I'm running enough to breath a little heavily, but she's still faster.
The long-haired girl enters the school.
Like a fluttering butterfly.
By the way...

page22.text:
There's no one on campus.
It's empty. Unoccupied.
The red-lit landscape is like a well-made candy diorama.
If the twilight glow grows any stronger, it'll melt them beyond recognition.
By the way...

page23.text:
I hear a girl laughing.
Two young girls smile and play with each other.
I see a vision of two beautiful sisters, so perfect for each other they might as well be twins.
I open the door and enter the classroom.
By the way...
Why was I following her for no reason?

page24.text:
It doesn't surprise me, nor do I feel any guilt.
The two of them embrace each other like lovers. It's enough to make me doubt that they're both girls.
Against this crimson backdrop, what they're doing seems only proper.
But if there's one thing that I'm curious about,
it's that Mitsuzuri's arms hang limply at her side, like those of a corpse.

page25.text:
I was wrong.
That isn't a hug.
It's a meal.
The praying mantis feeds on the butterfly.

page26.text:
It giddily drains its prey of life.
Mitsuzuri is like a wax model. With each second, her vitality is drained away.
Tohsaka's eyes are warm and whimsical.
Her face approaches Mitsuzuri's neck.
She exposes Mitsuzuri's defenseless, pale throat.
Then, Tohsaka's lips—no, her teeth...

page27.text:
The wax model's chest arches in tension.
I try to go over and help her, but I may as well be wading through a swamp.
I'll never make it in time.
I simply watch as Tohsaka purrs while she drinks, as Mitsuzuri goes weak at the knees.

page28.text:
"Hm...mmm..."
She licks her fingers.
Her wet tongue seductively slithers around her fingers.
It's too alluring.
I feel like I'm drowning in the thick air around her.

page29.text:
"Heh heh heh...mmm..."
Tohsaka giggles, licking her fingers.
The wet sound tickles my ears.

page30.text:
"I'm glad you came, Emiya."
Her voice sounds so sticky and expectant.
I'm so dizzy, it's like I'm inside a kaleidoscope.
My mind is paralyzed, to say nothing of my limbs.
Though, I should mention...
I've long since lost control over my body.

page31.text:
"What's wrong...? Are you afraid of me, Emiya?"
I can't even move my head to respond.
Her smile is irresitably bewitching, yet so terrifying, I feel like I'll be caught and killed.
I'm a winged insect caught in a spider's web.
I can neither fight nor flee.

page32.text:
"Ayako was delicious."
So she was eating after all.
But still...why Mitsuzuri?

page33.text:
"I just couldn't take the hunger while I was waiting for you."
Delight seeps into her giggles.
Tohsaka's hands reach out.
For some reason, I imagine her slender, supple arms, coiling around my body like a snake.
Her sweet scent envelops me and dominates my lungs.

page34.text:
"Hehe... You're next."
Tohsaka's limbs wrap around me.
Her soft, feminine body drowns out the blaring alarm in my head.

page35.text:
I feel like I'm crumbling in her embrace.
She brings her face close enough for our lips to touch. Her wet eyes invite me in.
Her breath is so thick, I'm going to suffocate in it.

page36.text:
"Mm... Now I'm going to eat you, Emiya."
Tohsaka's lips touch me,
nipping the side of my neck.
They're warm...and damp.
My mind melts like candy under their tender touch.

page37.text:
"Mmm..."
Sharp fangs pierce my skin.
Tohsaka's biting me.
Her teeth sink into my neck, just like with Mitsuzuri...

page38.text:
There's no pain.
I've heard that spiders anesthetize their prey before killing them.
With the numbness also comes ecstasy. Her sucking lips and teeth feel so good it's like I'm melting.

page39.text:
...My neck softly melts.
Each time Tohsaka drains a mouthful out of me, I feel my body turn to candy.
My insides are being sucked out and replaced with honey that makes my body melt.
It seeps into my bones, muscles, and skin.

page40.text:
It floods my throat, and I can't even moan.
It flows down from my neck, the unbelievable sensation beguiling me.
Tohsaka's shoulders tremble in ecstasy as she drinks from my neck.
She looks so pleased by the meal of red blood...

page41.text:
My consciousness is coated in a messy, overlapping carpet of vertigo.
Before I know it, I've stopped breathing, and my blood is being drained before it can even reach my brain.
In return, Tohsaka's sweet, strong liquid invades my body.

page42.text:
"Ah...mm. Delicious..."
While she nibbles at me, I hear a voice that doesn't belong.
The voice numbs my melting brain.

page43.text:
"Haah...mm... You're so hot...Emiya..."
She whispers, drinking me dry.
A pump empties me out from the inside.
In return, pleasure saturates my body, melting and turning it limp.

page44.text:
"Your fresh, youthful blood is so tasty and full of life..."
I'm at my limit.
I have nothing else to give.
My arteries are bone dry. I don't think I have even a drop of blood left to spare.

page46.text:
She continues drinking.
There shouldn't be anything left to drink, but I still hear Tohsaka gulping.
It's as if my life itself is being converted into blood.
That makes sense. Then, this meal isn't quite over yet.

page47.text:
She keeps drinking and drinking.
In the crimson-lit classroom, she drains me without end.
My body melts beyond recognition, fading to oblivion as she sucks it all up.

page48.text: "Mm... You're wonderful, Emiya. I'll take all of you."

page49.text:
A woman's voice reverberates in my mind.
I wither away, dessicated, while she whispers.
